name: 复古胶片日记
description: 褪色暖调、颗粒漏光、日期戳与手写体。情绪向内容转化高，资产的几何与质感成分最容易被提示词锁死，适合作为第一套跑通的配方。

blocks.en: faded warm analog film photograph, 1990s disposable camera look, quiet everyday moment
muted amber, faded cream, dusty brown, a touch of brick red, low saturation, warm color cast
fine film grain, one subtle light leak in the corner, faint dust and hairline scratches, soft halation
warm late-afternoon window light, gentle bloom, slightly lifted shadows
centered subject with generous negative space, slight tilt, clean border around the frame
small orange date stamp in the corner, delicate handwritten caption, no readable body text

subject: an empty wooden desk by the window
a folded handwritten letter with a dried flower
a glass bottle holding wildflowers
an old film camera resting on a chair
a rainy street seen through a window
a half-finished cup of tea and an open book
asset_kind: empty 35mm film frame border with sprocket holes, clean center
small date-stamp sticker, isolated on plain background
soft light-leak overlay, isolated on plain background
handwritten caption label plate, isolated on plain background
film grain and scratch texture tile, seamless

negative: sharp digital clarity, HDR, oversaturated colors, modern UI, watermark, logo, realistic human face, celebrity, text-heavy layout, 3D render, plastic look
notes: 提示词里的中文只用于界面显示，实际拼接全部使用 en 字段。先跑 30 张 Low 档挑 10 张定基调，再放量。
